notes: Both substantival articles take *that which* whole and head on *that*, which is rule 77's unanimous corpus reading for τὸ; no participle follows in either clause to claim the relativizer under rule 32.

The supplied copulas are placed by rule 53 on what is left to carry them — the adjective τέλειον in the first clause, the preposition ἐκ in the second — following rule 32's treatment of an article whose modifier is a prepositional phrase.
μέρους stands bare and no compound prepositional unit is built, the ASV writing two English words (rule 94).
